annotations.exact_quote: we propose a goal-directed deep learning approach, Deep Attentional Embedded Graph Clustering (DAEGC for short).
annotations.reason_zh: 提出面向图聚类的深度学习框架DAEGC，以可学习图表示和聚类过程获得数据划分，符合深度聚类定义。

annotations.exact_quote: By employing an attention network to capture the importance of the neighboring nodes to a target node, our DAEGC algorithm encodes the topological structure and node content in a graph to a compact representation
annotations.reason_zh: 用注意力网络对邻居节点加权并编码拓扑结构与节点内容，属于图上的可学习消息传递/图注意力表示机制。

annotations.exact_quote: soft labels from the graph embedding itself are generated to supervise a self-training graph clustering process, which iteratively refines the clustering results.
annotations.reason_zh: 将图嵌入自身产生的软标签作为后续训练监督，并迭代精炼聚类结果，符合伪标签与自训练定义。

annotations.exact_quote: Our method focuses on attributed graphs to sufficiently explore the two sides of information in graphs.
annotations.reason_zh: 节点拓扑结构与节点内容被视为图中两类互补信息，并被显式联合编码利用，符合多视图/多观测联合学习设定。
